title: adapter MANIFEST.json
description: A registered adapter: `/srv/pinka/models/adapters/<name>/<sha256>/MANIFEST.json`, written by the GPU arbiter when a training run succeeds (BUILD_PROMPT §7.18), root-owned and read-only. Deployment specs name the adapter as `<name>@<sha256>` in `adapter_ids`.

sha256.description: The adapter hash (see files); the directory name.

base_model_id.description: Model id (models.lock.yml) of the base model the adapter was trained on; null for a job without a base model. vLLM serves the adapter only with this model.

run.description: The training run that produced it.

path.description: Path relative to the adapter's directory, with / separators.

files.description: Every regular file of the adapter, sorted by path; the adapter hash is the SHA-256 of the lines `<sha256>  <path>` of this list, each ending in a newline (the output format of `sha256sum`).
